prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "en skyldighet". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "obligation".
Scene: A responsible animal caretaker filling a rabbit's water bowl and providing fresh hay in a clean spacious enclosure, attentive rabbit visible, a simple checklist nearby without readable words.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "skyldighet = obligation; picture a responsibility you must fulfill.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Vi har en skyldighet att ta hand om djuren.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
